# grafana_incident_custom_field (Resource)

Manages a Grafana Incident custom field, which records extra information on every incident, such as the affected team or the customer impact.

The Incident API enforces a few rules that affect Terraform:

* The slug must be unique within the organization. It can be changed without replacing the field.
* The type cannot be changed after the field is created, so changing `type` replaces the field.
* A select option is identified by its value. Changing an option's label, description, color or icon updates it in place, but changing its value deletes the option and adds a new one. Option values must be unique within the field.
* **A field or select option that is a value on any incident, open or resolved, cannot be deleted**, archived or not. Deleting it, removing the option, or changing the option's value or the field's type, which deletes and creates it again, fails. To stop managing a field with Terraform without deleting it, use a `removed` block with `lifecycle { destroy = false }`.
* To retire a field or a select option that incidents use, archive it instead: set `archived = true`. Archived fields and options can't be used on new incidents, but incidents that already use them keep them.
* Default values are not managed by this resource, since the Incident API does not expose them. A default set in the UI is kept.

Only fields in the `incident` domain are supported. Fields synced with Grafana labels and system-managed fields cannot be imported.

* [Official documentation](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/alerting-and-irm/irm/incident/)
* [API documentation](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/alerting-and-irm/irm/incident/api/)

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "grafana_incident_custom_field" "affected_team" {
  name        = "Affected team"
  slug        = "affected_team"
  type        = "single-select"
  description = "The team that owns the affected service."

  select_option {
    value = "payments"
    label = "Payments"
  }

  select_option {
    value       = "checkout"
    label       = "Checkout"
    description = "Cart, checkout and order confirmation."
  }

  # Archived options can't be selected on new incidents, but incidents that
  # already use them keep them.
  select_option {
    value    = "billing"
    label    = "Billing"
    archived = true
  }
}

resource "grafana_incident_custom_field" "customer_ticket" {
  name     = "Customer ticket"
  slug     = "customer_ticket"
  type     = "string"
  required = true
}

resource "grafana_incident_custom_field" "customer_impact" {
  name        = "Customer impact"
  slug        = "customer_impact"
  type        = "bool"
  description = "Whether customers were affected."
  required    = true
}

resource "grafana_incident_custom_field" "customers_notified_at" {
  name = "Customers notified at"
  slug = "customers_notified_at"
  type = "date"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The display name of the custom field, for example `Affected team`.
- `slug` (String) The slug of the custom field, used to search for it and to reference it as a metric. Up to 63 letters, digits and underscores, starting and ending with a letter. It must be unique within the organization.
- `type` (String) The type of the custom field. One of `string`, `single-select`, `multi-select`, `number`, `bool` (shown as Yes/No) or `date` (shown as Date & time). Changing it forces a new custom field to be created, which fails if any incident has a value for the field.

### Optional

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the custom field is archived. Archived fields can't be used on new incidents, but incidents that already use them keep their values. Defaults to `false`.
- `color` (String) The color of the custom field, as a CSS color such as `#FF5286`.
- `description` (String) A description of what the custom field records.
- `icon` (String) The name of the icon shown for the custom field.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether the custom field must be filled in on every incident. An incident cannot be resolved until it is set; for a `bool` field, No counts as set. Defaults to `false`.
- `select_option` (Block Set) An option of a `single-select` or `multi-select` field. Options are identified by their value, which must be unique within the field. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--select_option))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The UUID of the custom field.
- `select_option_ids` (Map of String) The UUIDs of the select options, keyed by the option value.

<a id="nestedblock--select_option"></a>
### Nested Schema for `select_option`

Required:

- `label` (String) The display label of the option.
- `value` (String) The value of the option, which identifies it. Changing it deletes the option and adds a new one, which fails if any incident has the option selected. Up to 63 letters, digits, `-`, `_` and `.`, starting and ending with a letter or digit.

Optional:

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the option is archived. Archived options can't be selected on new incidents, but incidents that already use them keep them. Defaults to `false`.
- `color` (String) The color of the option, as a CSS color such as `#FF5286`.
- `description` (String) A description of when the option applies.
- `icon` (String) The name of the icon shown for the option.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import grafana_incident_custom_field.name "{{ id }}"
```
